# WallMock

> WallMock is a wall art mockup generator for print-on-demand sellers on Etsy and Shopify: your exact art in styled rooms as framed or stretched canvas, or framed prints.

Your exact artwork in hundreds of realistic, curated rooms, for every design in your shop: set up favourite rooms once, add a whole collection, download listing-ready images. WallMock places your file as it is: it is never redrawn, repainted or upscaled by AI. Rooms are curated, digitally staged interiors reviewed by WallMock. Previews and images are made in your browser, on your device.

WallMock (wallmock.com) is not WallMockup (wallmockup.net). They are different products from different companies.
WallMock at wallmock.com is a mockup generator for wall art sellers. It is not the gallery-wall planner for homeowners at wallmock.app, which is a separate product with a similar name.

## Key facts (checked 2026-10-28)
- Who it is for: Print-on-demand and wall art sellers on Etsy and Shopify who sell framed canvas, stretched canvas, framed fine-art prints and posters.
- Products shown: Framed canvas (floating frame); Stretched canvas; Framed print, with or without a mat; Aluminum framed print (black, gold or silver), with or without a mat; Metal print (art on a frameless aluminium panel). Sets of 2, 3, 4.
- Metal prints: A metal print is your art printed on a thin aluminium panel: no frame, small rounded corners and a thin bare-metal edge, hung on a hidden block about ½ in (12.7 mm) off the wall so it casts a soft, tight shadow. The surface is gloss white with a gentle sheen. Metal prints are made in WallMock's rooms, one artwork per image. They are not available in sets yet. Examples: https://wallmock.com/metal-print-mockup/
- Rooms: 500+ curated room settings; images up to 4096 px. New rooms are added to the library over time.
- Frame quality: each image is a clean 4096 px render; floating frames show the gap around the canvas, frames have a natural shine and each piece casts a soft wall shadow, the quality you'd expect from a hand-built Photoshop mockup, made for a whole collection at once with no PSDs. Zoom in and check the corners at full size: https://wallmock.com/wall-art-mockup-examples/
- Price: Free watermarked previews in every room. Plans: Lite $5/month or $39/year: 200 clean 4K (4096 px) images a month; Pro $12/month or $89/year: Unlimited clean 4K (4096 px) images; Studio $24/month or $179/year: Unlimited clean 4K (4096 px) images. Fair use: up to 150 new rooms a day and 400 in 30 days, and up to 300 images a day made on WallMock's server (600 on Studio). Prices in USD; the app shows local prices in EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, INR and BRL.
- Image quality: Every clean image downloads in 4K (4096 px), high quality and ready to list.
- Try it free: Try WallMock free with no sign-up and no card: up to three artworks in 8 sample rooms, as watermarked previews made on your device. https://app.wallmock.com/try
- Access: Anyone can try free watermarked previews with no sign-up, then create a free account with Google or an email code.
- Billing: Plans are billed securely by Stripe from $5 a month. Cancel any time; new subscribers can get a refund within 14 days, minus credits used.
- Frames: Black, White, Natural oak, Walnut, Espresso, Gold, Silver. Design your own frame: pick wood grain, metallic or painted, then any colour with the colour picker or one of 21 one-click colours (5 woods, 6 metals and 10 paints). Some rooms keep only the frame looks we reviewed for them; custom frames work in all the others. Colours are close approximations, not a supplier's finish. Framed prints come with no mat or a mat in white, warm white, cream, warm grey or black.
- Speed: In our tests, a full-size 4096 px image takes about 7 to 12 seconds in the browser, and a laptop makes up to 4 images at once.
- Size and scale: Enter your artwork's real size in centimetres or inches (long side 4 to 60 in). In the 332 library rooms with a published estimated wall scale, the artwork can be drawn at that size against the room's scale, and size matches show the estimate's range; other rooms use a reviewed placement size. The scale is estimated from the room photo, not measured on a wall, so check sizes against your product. A 2000 px size guide image compares the sizes you sell, or example sizes, side by side without frames, labelled in centimetres and inches.
- History: WallMock has been in development since July 2026. Free previews opened to everyone on 26 October 2026, and paid plans on 28 October 2026.
- Works in a web browser; no Photoshop or PSD files.

- Contact: hello@wallmock.com

## Bulk Mockup Generator for Wall Art Collections
URL: https://wallmock.com/bulk-mockup-generator/
Make mockups for a whole wall art collection at once: save favourite rooms once, add every design, download each in every room. No Photoshop smart objects.

Short answer: a bulk mockup generator makes room mockups for many designs at once instead of one at a time. In WallMock you save your favourite rooms and frame choices once, add a whole collection, and get every artwork in every saved room. No PSD templates or smart objects, and each file is placed exactly as supplied, so a big batch needs no checking for redrawn art.

Q: Can I make multiple mockups at once?
A: Yes. In WallMock you save your favourite rooms once, add a whole collection, and every artwork is made in every saved room in one run. You do not repeat the setup for each design.
Q: How is this different from batch Photoshop mockups?
A: With PSD templates, each design goes into each template's smart object one by one, or you write an action or script to do it. WallMock needs no PSD files, actions or scripts: you choose rooms and the product once in your browser.
Q: Does bulk mockup work with Printify, Printful or Gelato designs?
A: Yes. Upload the same artwork files you send to your print provider and choose the matching product, such as framed canvas or a framed poster. Then use the images in your Etsy or Shopify listings.
Q: Is the quality high enough for Etsy zoom?
A: Clean images are up to 4096 px, and your artwork is placed as supplied, never upscaled or repainted by AI. Start from a high-resolution file for the sharpest result.
Q: How many images does a bulk run use?
A: Designs multiplied by rooms. 30 designs in 8 rooms is 240 images. Lite includes 200 clean 4K images a month; Pro and Studio include unlimited clean 4K (4096 px) images. Previews are free and watermarked.
Q: Can one batch mix square, portrait and panoramic art?
A: Yes. Each artwork keeps its own proportions and is never stretched. Room options vary by artwork shape, so a room reviewed for portrait art may not offer a panoramic piece.
Q: Do I lose my setup after the first collection?
A: No. Your favourite rooms and product choices are saved, so the next collection reuses them. That is where most of the time saving comes from.

## Canvas Print Mockup Generator: Stretched and Gallery Wrap
URL: https://wallmock.com/canvas-print-mockup-generator/
Make canvas listing photos that show the product: stretched canvas or a floating frame with its visible gap. Your exact art in curated rooms, whole collections.

Short answer: a canvas print mockup generator shows your artwork as a canvas hanging in a room. WallMock offers stretched canvas with no frame and framed canvas in a floating frame, with the gap between canvas and frame visible, in 500+ curated rooms. Your file is placed exactly as supplied and keeps its proportions, for one design or a whole collection.

Q: What is a floating frame canvas?
A: A stretched canvas mounted inside an open frame with a narrow gap between the canvas edge and the frame. The canvas is fixed from behind, so it looks as if it floats. It is also called a floater frame.
Q: Does a canvas print need a frame?
A: No. A stretched canvas is ready to hang as it is, with the image or a colour wrapped around its sides. A floating frame is an upgrade that adds a finished edge and protects the corners.
Q: What is the difference between stretched canvas and framed canvas?
A: A stretched canvas is fabric pulled over a wooden bar frame and hung bare. A framed canvas is the same stretched canvas placed in a frame, usually a floating frame. The image is the same; the edge and the price are different.
Q: Why should a canvas mockup show the gap?
A: Because the gap is what tells buyers it is a floating-frame canvas and not a framed print. A mockup that hides it, or draws a mat instead, sets the wrong expectation.
Q: Can I show panoramic or tall canvases?
A: Yes, in rooms reviewed for those shapes. Your file keeps its own proportions and is never stretched, from square to wide panoramic and tall pieces.
Q: Will the canvas texture change my artwork?
A: WallMock places your file as it is: it is never redrawn, repainted or upscaled by AI. The colours and details in the photo come from your own file.

## Frame Mockup Generator for Framed Prints, Mats and Colours
URL: https://wallmock.com/frame-mockup-generator/
Show your art in the frame your buyer orders: black, white, natural oak, walnut, espresso, gold or silver, with or without a mat. Your exact file, no Photoshop.

Short answer: a frame mockup generator puts your artwork inside a picture frame on a room wall. WallMock does it for framed prints with or without a mat, framed posters and framed canvas, in black, white, natural oak, walnut, espresso, gold or silver. Or design your own frame: wood grain, metallic or painted, in any colour you choose. Your file is placed as supplied, never redrawn, so the framed photo matches the print.

Q: What is a frame mockup?
A: A frame mockup is an image of your artwork inside a picture frame, usually hanging on a wall in a room. It shows buyers the frame colour, the mat and the size before they order.
Q: Is there a picture frame mockup generator that works online?
A: Yes. WallMock runs in your web browser, so there are no PSD files, smart objects or Photoshop. Previews and images are made in your browser, on your device.
Q: Which frame colour should my listing show?
A: The one you ship first. If you offer several colours, use your best seller in the hero photo and show the others in later photos, ideally the same artwork in the same room so buyers compare only the frame.
Q: Should a framed print mockup have a mat?
A: Only if the product has one. A mat suits photography, botanicals and line art, and makes small prints look more finished. If your print provider ships the frame without a mat, show it without one.
Q: What is the difference between a framed print and a framed poster mockup?
A: Very little in the photo: both show paper behind a frame. Framed fine-art prints more often have a mat and a heavier paper. Describe the paper and glazing in your listing text, since a photo cannot show them.
Q: Will the frame cover part of my artwork?
A: Plan for it. In a real frame the lip or mat overlaps the edge of the print slightly, so keep signatures and text away from the very edge. WallMock keeps your file's own proportions and never stretches it to fit a frame.

## Framed Canvas Mockup Generator: Floating Frame, 500+ Rooms
URL: https://wallmock.com/framed-canvas-mockup-generator/
Framed canvas mockups with the real floating-frame gap, in 7 frame colours and 500+ curated rooms. Your exact art, whole collections, free previews.

Short answer: a framed canvas mockup generator shows your artwork as a stretched canvas in a floating frame, hanging in a room. WallMock draws the narrow shadow gap between canvas and frame, the detail that tells buyers it is a framed canvas and not a framed print, in 7 frame colours and 500+ curated rooms. Your exact file, for your whole collection.

Q: What is a framed canvas mockup?
A: A listing photo that shows your artwork as a stretched canvas inside a frame, hanging in a room. For most print-on-demand sellers that frame is a floating frame, so the mockup should show the narrow gap between the canvas edge and the frame.
Q: What is a floating frame for canvas?
A: A floating frame, or floater frame, is an open frame that holds a stretched canvas from behind with a small gap all round. From the front you see a thin line of shadow between canvas and frame, so the canvas seems to float. It has no glass and no mat.
Q: Is a framed canvas the same as a floating frame canvas?
A: Usually, in print on demand. Prodigi calls its framed canvas a floater frame with a 5 mm gap, Gelato states a 12 mm gap between canvas and frame, and Printful's framed canvas reviews describe a floater frame. Check your own provider's product page, because some frames sit tight against the canvas.
Q: Do floating frames have glass?
A: No. A floating frame shows the canvas surface directly, with no glass, glazing or mat. If your product has glass and a mat, it is a framed print; use the frame mockup generator instead.
Q: Which frame colours can I show?
A: black, white, natural oak, walnut, espresso, gold and silver, so you can match the finish your provider ships. Or design your own frame: wood grain, metallic or painted, in any colour you choose.
Q: Can I make framed canvas mockups for my whole collection?
A: Yes. Heart the rooms you sell in, set the framed canvas look once, then add many artworks. Each one comes out in every chosen room at its own proportions.
Q: Is there a free framed canvas mockup generator?
A: Try WallMock free with no sign-up and no card: up to three artworks in 8 sample rooms, as watermarked previews made on your device. Clean full-size images come with a plan, from $5 a month.
Q: Will the mockup change my artwork?
A: WallMock places your file as it is: it is never redrawn, repainted or upscaled by AI.

## Gallery Wall Mockup Generator for Pairs, Trios and Sets
URL: https://wallmock.com/gallery-wall-mockup-generator/
Show pairs, trios and sets of four on one wall with even spacing and matching frames. Your exact artwork in curated rooms, with free spacing and layout tools.

Short answer: a gallery wall mockup generator shows several artworks hanging together, so buyers see the set as one piece. WallMock shows pairs, trios and sets of four with matching frames and even gaps, in curated rooms with wall space for a group. Each file is placed exactly as supplied. For bigger or mixed walls, plan the layout with the free planner.

Q: How many pieces can a WallMock gallery wall mockup show?
A: Sets of 2, 3 or 4 pieces on one wall: pairs, trios and sets of four. For a larger salon-style wall, plan it with the free gallery wall layout planner.
Q: How far apart should pieces in a set hang?
A: Even gaps of about 3 to 6 inches (8 to 15 cm) look tidy for most sets. Smaller pieces can sit closer; very large canvases can sit a little further apart. The gallery wall spacing calculator does the sums.
Q: What is the difference between a triptych and a set of 3?
A: A triptych is one image split across three panels, so the panels only make sense together. A set of 3 is three separate artworks that share a theme, colour or style. Both are shown as three matching frames in a row.
Q: Can I mock up a gallery wall with different sizes?
A: WallMock sets are made for matching pieces. For mixed sizes, use the layout planner to plan the arrangement, then show each piece on its own in a room.
Q: Should every piece in a set use the same frame?
A: For a set you sell together, yes. One frame colour and one size makes the group read as a single piece. Mixed frames suit eclectic gallery walls, which are harder to sell as one product.
Q: Will each artwork in the set stay exact?
A: WallMock places your file as it is: it is never redrawn, repainted or upscaled by AI. Each piece keeps its own file, so the set in the photo is the set you ship.

## Mockup Generator That Doesn't Change Your Art, Measured
URL: https://wallmock.com/how-wallmock-keeps-your-art-exact/
WallMock places your file as it is, never redrawn by AI. See how we measured exact art on our published examples, why it matters on Etsy, and what to check.

Short answer: WallMock is a mockup generator that doesn't change your art. WallMock places your file as it is: it is never redrawn, repainted or upscaled by AI. On the 61 room images in our published example set, the art matched its source file with a structural similarity of at least 0.99 out of 1 and an average colour difference of 0.72 or less, too small for most people to see. The room is a digitally staged scene; your art is exact.

Q: Does WallMock change my artwork?
A: No. WallMock places your file as it is: it is never redrawn, repainted or upscaled by AI. It keeps its own proportions and is never stretched to fit a room.
Q: Is there a mockup generator that doesn't redraw your art with AI?
A: Yes. WallMock places your file as supplied, so lettering, signatures and colours stay as you made them. Some AI mockup tools draw a new picture, art included. Test any tool by zooming in on text in your own file.
Q: What do structural similarity and colour difference mean?
A: Structural similarity compares the shapes, edges and detail of two images: 1 means identical. Colour difference measures how far apart two colours are: 0 means the same colour, and about 2.3 is usually given as the smallest difference most people can notice.
Q: Does the app run these checks on every image I make?
A: These numbers come from WallMock's published example set, not from a check on each image you make. Your file is placed the same way: it is never redrawn, repainted or upscaled by AI. You can zoom in on any download to check it yourself.
Q: Is the room a photo of someone's home?
A: No. Rooms are curated, digitally staged interiors reviewed by WallMock. Only the artwork comes from your file, and it is placed exactly as supplied.
Q: Do I still need a photo of the actual print for Etsy?
A: Etsy's listing image rules (updated 22 October 2026): most listings need at least one unedited photo of the actual item against a real background, with no editing or AI tools on that photo. Other photos may be edited if they show the item accurately. Print-on-demand items made by a production partner may use an authorised mockup instead, and digital downloads need a preview of the content. So use WallMock images for your room and detail photos, and add one real photo of the print or canvas unless you sell print on demand or downloads.

Q: Aluminium or aluminum: is there a difference?

Q: Will the frame or mat cover part of my print?

## Metal Print Mockup: Frameless Aluminium Panels in Rooms
URL: https://wallmock.com/metal-print-mockup/
Show your art as a metal print: a frameless aluminium panel with rounded corners, floating off the wall, in 500+ curated rooms. Your exact file, never redrawn.

Short answer: A metal print mockup shows your art printed on a metal panel, hanging in a room. Q: What is a metal print mockup?
A: A photo of your artwork printed on a metal panel, usually aluminium, hanging on a room wall. It shows buyers the frameless look, the thin edge and how the panel sits off the wall, before they order.
Q: Does WallMock make metal print mockups?
A: Yes. In the Studio, choose Metal, then Metal print. A metal print is your art printed on a thin aluminium panel: no frame, small rounded corners and a thin bare-metal edge, hung on a hidden block about ½ in (12.7 mm) off the wall so it casts a soft, tight shadow. The surface is gloss white with a gentle sheen.
Q: Can I show a metal print in a set of 2, 3 or 4?
A: Not yet. Metal prints are made in WallMock's rooms, one artwork per image. They are not available in sets yet. Sets work with canvas and framed prints.
Q: Is my artwork changed?
A: WallMock places your file as it is: it is never redrawn, repainted or upscaled by AI. The panel's corners, edge and shadow are drawn around your file; the art itself comes from your file.
Q: What is the difference between a metal print and an aluminum framed print?
A: A metal print is the art itself printed on an aluminium panel, with no frame and no mat. An aluminum framed print is a paper print behind a slim aluminium frame, in black, gold or silver, with or without a mat. Show the one your provider ships.
Q: Glossy or matte?
A: WallMock shows the panel with a gloss white surface and a gentle sheen. If your provider sells a matte or brushed-metal finish instead, say so in the listing, and check your sample against the photo.

## Poster Mockup Generator for Framed Posters and Prints
URL: https://wallmock.com/poster-mockup-generator/

Your file is placed exactly as it is, so lettering and colours match the print, and you can run a whole poster collection at once.

A: A tool that shows your poster design on a wall in a room, so a buyer can judge its size, colours and style before ordering. WallMock does this online, with no PSD file or Photoshop needed.
Q: Can I show a poster without a frame?
A: Not at the moment. WallMock shows posters in a frame: wood or aluminium, with or without a mat. If you ship paper only, say "frame not included" in the first lines of your listing so the photo and the product match.
Q: What size should a poster file be for a 24x36 print?
A: At 300 DPI a 24x36 inch poster needs 7200 x 10800 pixels. Many sellers accept less for large posters viewed from a distance. Check your own file with the free print resolution checker.
Q: What ratio is an A-size poster?
A: A1, A2, A3 and A4 all share one shape, about 1:1.41. That is close to 5:7, but not the same as the 2:3 shape of 24x36 or the 3:4 shape of 18x24.
Q: Will text and lettering on my poster stay sharp?
A: WallMock places your file as it is: it is never redrawn, repainted or upscaled by AI. Typography, signatures and fine lines show exactly as they are in your file.
Q: Can I mock up a whole poster collection at once?
A: Yes. Save the rooms you like once, add every poster in the collection, and each design is made in each saved room.

A: On 2026-10-29 WallMockup's Pro Monthly plan was $4.99 a month with exports not capped, plus 10 credits a month, and a $5.99 one-time pack of 100 credits. Its 10 credits a month buy 2 preview 1K AI rooms or 1 listing-ready 2K AI room, and no page we read states its export size in pixels. WallMock's Lite is $5 a month for 200 clean 4K images, and Pro, at $12, includes unlimited clean 4K (4096 px) images. Fair use: up to 150 new rooms a day and 400 in 30 days, and up to 300 images a day made on WallMock's server (600 on Studio). WallMockup costs less a month; every WallMock image is a full-size 4K file.
Q: Which has better frame quality?

WallMock's wall art mockup examples open every frame at full size, so you can check the corners, the floating-frame gap, the shine and the wall shadow; its frames come in 7 finishes plus any colour you design, and framed prints in 20 mm wood, 31.75 mm gallery wood or slim aluminum, with or without a mat. WallMockup lists 54 frame styles with adjustable thickness and an optional mat.

Q: Does WallMockup show art at true scale?
A: Yes, according to its own home page: every scene is measured, so the print shows at the size you sell, in inches and centimetres. The scale is estimated from the room photo, not measured on a wall, so check sizes against your product.
