## AI Mockup Generator for Wall Art: Exact Art or Redrawn?
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/ai-wall-art-mockup-generator/
Some AI mockup generators redraw your art with the room, changing text, signatures and colours. Learn why print sellers need the exact file placed instead.

Short answer: An AI mockup generator either regenerates the whole picture, room and artwork together, or places your exact file into a scene. Regenerating can quietly change lettering, signatures, colours and proportions. Then the listing no longer matches the print the buyer receives. For print sellers, choose a tool that places your file as supplied, and zoom in to check the art before you upload. WallMock places your file as it is: it is never redrawn by AI.

Q: Does an AI mockup generator use my exact artwork or redraw it?
A: It depends on the tool. Some regenerate the whole image, art included, which can change text, signatures and colours. Others place your file as supplied. Test with a file that has small text and compare at 200% zoom.
Q: Does WallMock use AI to change my artwork?
A: No. WallMock places your file as it is: it is never redrawn, repainted or upscaled by AI. Rooms are curated, digitally staged interiors reviewed by WallMock.
Q: Do I need to disclose AI-generated mockups on Etsy?
A: Etsy's AI disclosure rule is about items created with AI. Listing photos fall under Etsy's listing image requirements, which allow edits that don't misrepresent the item. Etsy also recommends noting in your description if any listing photos were edited with AI. Read both Etsy pages for your case, because rules change.
Q: Can I use AI to edit my Etsy listing photos?
A: Etsy says you can use AI tools to adjust lighting or colour, crop or change backgrounds in photos other than your required unedited photo, as long as the item doesn't look different from what buyers receive.
Q: Is there an AI wall art mockup generator without a watermark?
A: Free tiers differ between tools. WallMock gives free watermarked previews in every room; clean, full-size images come with a plan. Whatever tool you use, check that the art is unchanged.
Q: Can I use Midjourney to make wall art mockups?
A: You can use it to make empty room backgrounds if its terms suit your use. Don't let it draw your artwork: place your real file on top, at the right ratio and size.

## Are AI Mockups Allowed on Etsy? Rules for Wall Art Sellers
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/are-ai-mockups-allowed-on-etsy/
Etsy allows edited and AI-assisted listing photos if they show exactly what the buyer gets. What its rules say, the unedited-photo rule, and why art must stay exact.

Short answer: Yes, within limits. Etsy lets you edit listing photos, including with AI, as long as they accurately show what the buyer will receive. Most items also need at least one unedited photo of the actual item; for print-on-demand items, Etsy allows a stock photo mockup if its owner has authorised its use. So an AI-made room can be fine, but AI-redrawn art is not: if the art in the photo differs from the print, the photo misrepresents the item.

Q: Are mockups allowed on Etsy?
A: Yes. Etsy allows edited images, including mockups, as long as they accurately show what the buyer receives. Most physical items also need at least one unedited photo of the actual item.
Q: Can I use AI-generated mockups on Etsy?
A: You can use AI to make or edit the room, as long as the item is shown accurately. Don't let a tool redraw the artwork itself, because the photo then shows a different picture from the print.
Q: Do I need an unedited photo of my print on Etsy?
A: For most items, yes. For print-on-demand items, Etsy says you may use a stock photo mockup if its owner has authorised its use. A photo of a sample is still the strongest proof.
Q: Do I have to say my photos are mockups?
A: Etsy recommends noting in the description whether images were edited. One plain line saying the room photos are digitally staged mockups covers it.
Q: Is AI-redrawn art in a mockup against Etsy's rules?
A: If the redrawn art differs from what you ship, the photo no longer accurately represents the item, which Etsy's image rules require. Keep the artwork exact and stage only the room.
Q: Can I use WallMock images on Etsy?
A: Yes. WallMock's terms allow clean downloads in shop listings. The artwork is your file, placed as it is, and you should still follow Etsy's photo rules.

## Print on Demand Wall Art: How to Choose a Provider
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/best-print-on-demand-for-wall-art/
Printify, Printful, Gelato, Prodigi, Lumaprints and Gooten compared on wall art products, where they print and Etsy and Shopify links, using dated facts.

Short answer: No single print-on-demand provider is best for every wall art shop. Choose by three things: the exact product you sell (framed canvas, stretched canvas or framed print), where your buyers live, and whether it connects to Etsy or Shopify. Printify, Printful, Gelato, Prodigi, Lumaprints and Gooten all list wall art and connect to both platforms, but their frames and print locations differ. Order samples before you list. Then make listing photos that match the product you chose.

Q: What is the best print on demand for wall art?
A: It depends on your product, your buyers' countries and your sales channel. Shortlist providers that make your exact product (framed canvas, stretched canvas or framed print), print near your buyers and connect to Etsy or Shopify, then order samples and compare.
Q: Printful vs Printify for posters: what's the difference?
A: Printful runs its own fulfilment centres and chooses one per order. Printify connects you to a network of print providers, so quality, price and location depend on the provider you pick. Both offer framed and unframed posters and connect to Etsy and Shopify.
Q: Does Printful or Printify offer framed canvas?
A: Yes. Printify lists framed canvas with a pine wood frame. Printful lists framed canvas alongside standard and thin canvas. Frame colours depend on the product and provider, so check before you make mockups.
Q: Which print on demand providers print in the UK or Europe?
A: For wall art, Printful lists centres in Spain and the UK (UK addresses only); Riga handles apparel. Prodigi says it has its own facilities in the UK and EU. Gelato says it produces locally in 32 countries. Printify depends on the print provider you choose.
Q: Do I have to list my print provider on Etsy?
A: Yes. Etsy requires sellers who use production assistance to disclose it on the relevant listings. Add the provider under Shop Manager, Settings, Partners you work with, then choose it on each listing.
Q: Can I use my own mockups with a print on demand provider?
A: Yes. Printify lets you upload custom mockups to its Mockup Library. With Printful you add them directly to your Etsy or Shopify listing. Make sure the mockup matches the real product.

## Bulk Upload Wall Art to Printify and Etsy With Room Mockups
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/bulk-upload-wall-art-to-printify-and-etsy/
A step-by-step workflow for a whole wall art collection on Printify and Etsy: one template product, duplicates, bulk publishing, and your own room photos.

Short answer: Build one Printify product as a template, duplicate it for each artwork and swap the design: Printify keeps the variants, prices, descriptions and provider settings. Make every room photo in one batch, named by artwork. Attach them per product in Printify's Mockup Library, or add them on Etsy and publish later updates with Mockups unticked. Printify can publish selected products together and Etsy can bulk-edit text fields, but photos go on one listing at a time.

Q: Can I bulk upload designs to Printify?
A: Printify's help centre describes duplicating a product and changing its design, saving artwork templates, and publishing many products at once. We found no article on uploading many designs as separate products in one step (checked 2026-10-29).
Q: Does duplicating a Printify product copy the mockups?
A: Yes. Printify says a duplicate keeps the variants, pricing, descriptions, mockups and print provider settings, so replace any custom mockups with the new artwork's photos.
Q: Can I add photos to many Etsy listings at once?
A: No. Etsy's bulk editing covers titles, tags, descriptions, prices, custom options, production partners, renewal options, processing and shipping profiles. Photos are added and reordered per listing.
Q: How many mockups can I publish from Printify to Etsy?
A: Up to 20 per product, across all colour variants. Publishing fails above that.
Q: How many room images will my collection need?
A: Artworks multiplied by rooms. 20 artworks in 6 rooms is 120 images. WallMock's Lite plan includes 200 clean 4K images a month; Pro and Studio include unlimited clean 4K (4096 px) images.
Q: Does WallMock upload to Printify or Etsy?
A: No. WallMock makes the room photos in bulk; you add them to Printify's Mockup Library or to your Etsy listings yourself.

## Bulk Mockup Workflow Checklist: Naming, Previews, Exports
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/bulk-wall-art-mockups-without-photoshop/
A repeatable bulk mockup workflow for wall art collections, without Photoshop: favourite rooms, a saved look, preview checks, the image count, then organised exports.

Short answer: Decide whether you are making separate images of many artworks or one set on a wall. Save a small shortlist of favourite rooms and one frame look, preview a pale, a dark and a colourful piece, and check the planned image count and any unavailable combinations. Then download and name the files by artwork and listing. No Photoshop templates are needed.

Q: Can I make wall art mockups in bulk without Photoshop?
A: Yes. Browser tools such as WallMock place each artwork in your saved rooms for you, with no PSD templates or smart objects to edit.
Q: How many rooms should a bulk batch use?
A: Start with a small shortlist that fits the product: a clear product-led room, a contextual interior and one complementary setting. Not every room belongs in every batch.
Q: Should every artwork in a collection use the same frame?
A: Consistency helps a shop look coherent, but don't force one frame onto every artwork if it misrepresents what you sell.

## Canva Wall Art Mockups: How to Make Them, and Their Limits
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/canva-wall-art-mockups/
How to make a wall art mockup in Canva, step by step from Canva's help page, and the checks that matter for framed canvas: crop, frame gap, scale and volume.

Short answer: In Canva, open a design, go to Elements, choose the Mockups category, pick a frame or poster scene and drag your artwork onto it, then adjust it with Fill, Fit or Smart Crop. It's quick for one poster or framed print. For framed canvas it falls short in three ways: a fill or crop can change your art's shape, a scene can only show the frame its photo already has, and each design is placed by hand.

Q: Can you make wall art mockups in Canva?
A: Yes. Canva's help page shows how: open Elements, choose the Mockups category, pick a scene, drag your artwork onto it and adjust it with Fill, Fit or Smart Crop.
Q: Do Canva custom mockups need a paid plan?
A: Canva's help page says creating custom mockup templates from your own photo is available on Pro, Teams, Enterprise, Education and Nonprofit plans. Check Canva for the current details.
Q: Why does my art look cropped in a Canva mockup?
A: A fill or crop setting trims the art to the mockup's shape. Use a scene with the same ratio as your art, or a setting that shows the whole image, and measure the result.
Q: Can Canva show a floating-frame canvas?
A: Only if the scene photo already contains one. The frame, its gap and its colour come from the photo, so match the scene to the product you sell.
Q: Can I make mockups for a whole collection in Canva?
A: Canva's help page describes placing each design into a mockup by hand. For many designs in the same rooms, a bulk mockup tool is faster.
Q: Can I use Canva mockups on Etsy?
A: That depends on Canva's licence terms for the elements you use and on Etsy's photo rules. Our mockup licence guide lists what to check.

## Canvas Depth 0.75 vs 1.5 Inch: Thin or Gallery Canvas?
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/canvas-depth-0-75-vs-1-5-inch/
Thin 0.75 in canvas or deep 1.5 in gallery canvas? What each depth suits, the depths Printful, Gelato and Prodigi actually make, and how to show depth in photos.

Short answer: Thin canvas is about 0.75 in (19 mm) deep and gallery canvas about 1.5 in (38 mm). Thin suits small and medium sizes, framing and a flatter look. Deep canvas stands further off the wall, suits large pieces hung without a frame and shows more of its edge. Providers differ: Printful's standard canvas is 1.25 in, Gelato makes 2 cm and 4 cm, Prodigi 19 mm and 38 mm (checked 2026-10-29). State the exact depth and show it in a side close-up.

Q: Is 0.75 or 1.5 inch canvas better?
A: Neither is better in general. Thin 0.75 in canvas suits smaller pieces and framing; deep 1.5 in canvas suits large pieces hung without a frame.
Q: What is a gallery depth canvas?
A: A deep stretched canvas, usually about 1.5 in (38 mm), hung without a frame with its sides finished. Prodigi's stretched canvas is 38 mm and Gelato's thick canvas 4 cm.
Q: How thick is a standard canvas print?
A: It depends on the provider. Printful's standard canvas is 1.25 in (3.18 cm), Prodigi's stretched canvas 38 mm and its slim canvas 19 mm (checked 2026-10-29).
Q: Can a 1.5 inch canvas go in a floating frame?
A: Yes, if the frame is made for that depth. Prodigi's floater, for example, holds a 38 mm canvas and stands 53 mm off the wall.
Q: Does canvas depth change the file size I need?
A: Only with image wrap. Then the picture covers the sides, so add the depth to every side: a 24 × 36 in canvas, 1.5 in deep, needs 27 × 39 in of picture.

## Canvas Print Sizes Chart: Stretched and Framed, by Ratio
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/canvas-print-sizes-chart/
Standard canvas print sizes grouped by ratio (1:1, 2:3, 3:4, 4:5, 1:2, 1:3) in inches and centimetres, plus framed canvas sizes and the pixels each size needs.

Short answer: Canvas sizes come in ratio families, and one file prints every size in its family without cropping. Square: 12×12, 16×16, 20×20, 24×24, 30×30 in. 2:3: 8×12, 12×18, 16×24, 20×30, 24×36, 40×60. 3:4: 9×12, 12×16, 18×24, 24×32, 30×40. 4:5: 8×10, 16×20, 24×30. Panoramic: 1:2 (12×24, 20×40) and 1:3 (12×36, 20×60). Framed canvas lists are shorter: Printful and Gelato stop at 24×36 in (checked 2026-10-29).

Q: What are the standard canvas sizes?
A: Common ones include 8×10, 11×14, 12×12, 12×16, 16×20, 18×24, 20×30, 24×36, 30×40 and 40×60 in. In centimetres: 30×40, 40×50, 50×70, 60×80 and 60×90 cm.
Q: Which canvas sizes are 2:3?
A: 8×12, 12×18, 16×24, 20×30, 24×36, 32×48 and 40×60 in, and 20×30, 40×60 and 60×90 cm. One 2:3 file prints all of them without cropping.
Q: Is 16×20 the same ratio as 8×10?
A: Yes, both are 4:5, as is 24×30. 11×14 and 20×24 are different ratios and need their own file or a crop.
Q: What is the biggest standard canvas size?
A: It depends on the provider. Printful's canvas list goes up to 40×60 in, and Prodigi's framed canvas up to 55×55 in (checked 2026-10-29). Check your provider before listing oversized pieces.
Q: Are framed canvas sizes the size of the frame or the canvas?
A: Providers differ, so check. The frame and its gap add to the outside size: with Prodigi's 5 mm gap and 12 mm face, about 34 mm on each side length.
Q: What size canvas goes over a sofa?
A: About two-thirds to three-quarters of the sofa's width. Over an 84 in sofa that is 56 to 63 in, such as a 40×60 in landscape.

## Canvas vs Framed Print Mockups: Which to Show for Your Art
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/canvas-vs-framed-print-mockups/
How stretched canvas, floating-frame canvas and framed prints with mats change the look of the same artwork, and which presentation suits which buyer.

Short answer: Show the product you sell. A stretched canvas has no frame and its image wraps the edges, which suits painterly and large pieces. A floating-frame canvas leaves a visible gap between canvas and frame and reads as premium. A framed print with a mat feels classic and suits photography, botanicals and line art. For printables, show a simple frame with a mat, because that is how most buyers display them.

Q: Is a floating frame the same as a regular frame?
A: No. A floating frame leaves a visible gap around the canvas so it appears to float; a regular picture frame overlaps the edge of the artwork, usually behind glass.
Q: Which looks more premium in a listing?
A: Floating-frame canvas and matted framed prints usually read as more premium than an unframed canvas, but the right choice is the product you actually sell.
Q: Should a printable be shown as a canvas?
A: Usually not. Most buyers print and frame a download behind glass, so a simple frame with a mat sets the right expectation.

## Canvas Wrap Edges: Mirror vs Image Wrap vs Colour Edge
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/canvas-wrap-edges/
Mirror wrap, image wrap (gallery wrap) or a plain white or black edge: what each does to your canvas art, the file each needs, and how to show the edge to buyers.

Short answer: The edge is the side of a stretched canvas. Image wrap, often called gallery wrap, folds part of the picture round the sides, so the front loses a strip on every side unless your file has extra image. Mirror wrap copies the outer strip onto the sides, so the front stays whole. A colour edge leaves the sides plain white or black. Choose mirror or colour for art with detail near its edges, and image wrap when the picture can spare a border.

Q: What is the difference between gallery wrap and mirror wrap?
A: With gallery (image) wrap, part of your picture folds round the sides, so the front loses a strip. With mirror wrap, the edge of the picture is copied onto the sides, so the front stays whole.
Q: Which canvas edge is best?
A: Mirror wrap or a colour edge if your art has detail, faces or text near its edges. Image wrap if the picture has a soft border it can spare, such as sky, water or texture.
Q: Does image wrap cut off part of my art?
A: From the front, yes, unless your file includes extra image for the sides. On a 1.5 in deep canvas, plan about 1.5 in of extra picture on every side.
Q: What is a museum wrap?
A: Usually a canvas with plain white sides. Prodigi uses the name for its white edge. Other printers use it loosely, so describe the sides in plain words.
Q: Does the edge matter for a framed canvas?
A: Much less. In a floating frame the sides sit inside the frame, so they are mostly hidden from the front.

## Christmas Wall Art Mockups and Seasonal Listing Photos
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/christmas-and-seasonal-wall-art-mockups/
How to stage Christmas, autumn and spring wall art listings: when to swap the hero photo, which cues read at thumbnail size, and the seasonal rooms WallMock has.

Short answer: Use a seasonal room for one or two photos, not the whole listing. A small tree, tartan cushions or a lit fireplace reads as Christmas at thumbnail size; tulips and daylight read as spring; wool, timber and a fire read as autumn and winter. Swap the hero photo six to eight weeks before the date, keep year-round rooms in the other slots, and swap back afterwards. WallMock has a handful of seasonal rooms, listed below.

Q: When should I add Christmas mockups to my listings?
A: In October, six to eight weeks before Christmas, so the seasonal photo is live while gift buyers are searching. Swap it back after the holiday.
Q: Should every photo in a listing be seasonal?
A: No. Use the seasonal room for the hero, and keep year-round rooms, the close-up, the flat artwork and the sizes image in the other slots.
Q: What makes a room look like Christmas in a thumbnail?
A: One or two large cues, such as a small tree, tartan or red textiles, or a garland on a mantel. Small ornaments disappear at thumbnail size.
Q: Does WallMock have Christmas rooms?
A: It has the Winter farmhouse living room, with a small Christmas tree and tartan cushions, for 3:2 artwork as a natural oak floating-frame canvas. It also has a few winter, fireplace, spring and Diwali rooms, listed in this guide.
Q: Can I use seasonal mockups for printables?
A: Yes. Show the printable in a simple frame with a mat, as buyers will display it, and say clearly that the frame and decor are not included.

## Consistent Etsy Shop Mockups: One Room Set per Collection
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/consistent-etsy-shop-mockups/
Make consistent Etsy shop mockups: choose a small set of rooms, one frame look and one hero style per collection, then reuse them for every artwork in it.

Short answer: Give each collection its own small room set and reuse it for every artwork in that collection: two or three hero rooms, one scale room, two or three alternative rooms and one frame look. Choose the rooms by the collection's palette, its artwork shape and the product you sell. Keep light, wall colours and styling in one family, so the shop reads as one brand in search, but rotate hero rooms so thumbnails don't look identical.

Q: Should every Etsy listing use the same mockup room?
A: Use the same small set of rooms across a collection, not one room for everything. Rotate two or three hero rooms so the search grid doesn't show the same photo many times.
Q: How many mockup rooms does a collection need?
A: Six or seven covers most listings: two or three hero rooms, one scale room and two or three alternatives, plus one frame look.
Q: Should different collections look different?
A: Yes. Each collection can have its own room set that suits its palette and buyer, while the shop keeps a common style in light and framing.
Q: Can I mix canvas and framed prints in one look?
A: Lead each listing with the product it sells. A collection can offer both, but keep one frame look per listing so the photos match what arrives.

## Etsy Listing Photos for Wall Art: A Plan for All 20 Slots
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/etsy-listing-photos-for-wall-art/
What to show in each Etsy photo slot for prints and canvas, in order: hero room, scale, detail, alternative rooms, sizes, sets and what's included.

Short answer: Use the first photo for a hero room where the art is large and clear, and the second for scale above familiar furniture. Then show the flat artwork, a close view of the frame or canvas edge, three to five alternative rooms, a sizes image, finish options and the matching set. Etsy allows up to 20 photos and a short video; every slot you use should answer one buyer question.

Q: How many photos can an Etsy listing have?
A: Up to 20 photos and a short video at the time of writing. Check Etsy's help centre for the current limits.
Q: What should the first Etsy photo of wall art be?
A: A room image where the artwork is large, centred and easy to recognise at thumbnail size, in a calm room that suits the art.
Q: Should I show the flat artwork too?
A: Yes, one image of the artwork on its own lets buyers see the full composition without room styling.
Q: Do I need a different room for every photo?
A: Use several different rooms, but repeat the hero room for the detail shot so the sequence feels connected.

## Etsy Print on Demand Integration for Wall Art: 5 Providers
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/etsy-print-on-demand-integrations-for-wall-art/
How Printify, Printful, Gelato, Prodigi and Gooten connect to Etsy for wall art, what each sends to your listing, and how to swap their mockups for room photos.

Short answer: All five connect to Etsy, but they work differently. Printify, Printful and Gelato create the listing for you, and Printful and Gelato add it as a draft. Prodigi imports listings you already made on Etsy. Gooten can push a draft or link an existing listing. Each handles photos its own way, so add your room photos the way your provider expects, list it as a production partner, and stay within Etsy's 20 photos.

Q: Which print-on-demand companies integrate with Etsy?
A: Printify, Printful, Gelato, Prodigi and Gooten all connect to Etsy. Etsy's own help page names Printful, Printify and Gooten as examples of print-on-demand production partners.
Q: Do I have to add my print provider as a production partner on Etsy?
A: Yes. Add it under Shop Manager, Settings, Partners you work with, then select it on your listings. Printful says you must select it each time you publish a product.
Q: Will my print provider overwrite my own Etsy photos?
A: It can. Printify says publishing its mockups replaces your Etsy mockups, including videos, so untick Mockups when you republish. Printful and Gelato add their mockups when they publish, so check the photo order afterwards.
Q: How many photos can an Etsy listing have?
A: Up to 20 photos and 2 videos. Gelato and Printful send up to 10 mockups, and Printify up to 20, so leave room for your own photos.
Q: Can I use mockups instead of a photo of the real item?
A: Etsy requires at least one unedited photo for most items, with a print-on-demand exception for stock photo mockups that the owner has authorised. Check Etsy's page for your product; a photo of your sample is the safest option.
Q: Can WallMock publish to Etsy for me?
A: No. WallMock makes the room photos; you add them to your Etsy listing or to your provider's mockup library yourself.

## Etsy SEO for Wall Art: Titles, Tags, Attributes for Canvas
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/etsy-seo-for-wall-art/
Etsy SEO for framed canvas and framed prints: what Etsy search reads, how to write the title, 13 tags that cover the product, and which attributes to fill.

Short answer: Etsy search reads your title, tags and attributes. For canvas and framed wall art, start the title with what the item is ("Misty Mountain Framed Canvas Wall Art"), keep it under 15 words, and use all 13 tags as multi-word phrases of up to 20 characters for product, subject, style, room and size. Fill every attribute your category offers, then let tags cover what attributes can't. Check Etsy Stats for the searches that actually find you.

Q: How many tags can an Etsy listing have?
A: Up to 13 tags, each up to 20 characters. Etsy's help page says short phrases work and that tags are most useful where no attribute matches.
Q: How long should an Etsy title be for wall art?
A: Etsy allows 140 characters but suggests fewer than 15 words, with the item described clearly at the start. Search engines such as Google show only about the first 50 to 60 characters of it.
Q: Should I put 'framed' in the title if the frame is optional?
A: Only if the item in the photos and the default option is framed. If the frame is an add-on, say 'frame option' or describe it in a variation, so buyers aren't misled.
Q: Does Etsy search read the description?
A: Etsy's help page on Stats says search scans titles, tags and attributes. Etsy still advises a clear first sentence in the description, and search engines such as Google read the whole page.
Q: Do attributes count as tags on Etsy?
A: They are separate fields, but both help buyers find your listing. Fill the attributes your category offers, then use tags for phrases attributes can't express.

## Etsy Thumbnail for Wall Art: A Crop-Safe First Photo
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/etsy-thumbnail-for-wall-art/
Make an Etsy thumbnail for wall art that survives Etsy's square, portrait and landscape crops: shape, size, where the art sits, and how to check it before you list.

Short answer: Your Etsy thumbnail is your first listing photo, and Etsy crops it to square, portrait and landscape views in different places. For wall art, use a landscape or square room photo at least 2000 px wide, taken from further back than feels natural, with the whole artwork in the centre and clear space on every side. Then preview it with Etsy's Adjust Thumbnail tool and fix the crop before you publish.

Q: What size is an Etsy thumbnail?
A: Etsy doesn't give a single thumbnail size, because it crops the first photo to square, portrait and landscape views in different places. It recommends listing photos of at least 2000 px, and at least 635 px for the first photo.
Q: Should my first Etsy photo be square or landscape?
A: Etsy says the first photo should be landscape or square, and its thumbnail tips recommend horizontal images. A landscape room photo with the art in the centre survives the crops best.
Q: Why is my Etsy thumbnail cutting off my art?
A: The art is too close to the edge of the photo. Use a photo taken from further back, keep the artwork in the middle, and adjust the thumbnail in the listing editor.
Q: How do I change my Etsy thumbnail?
A: Drag the photo you want into the first position, then use Adjust Thumbnail in the listing editor to zoom and position it.
Q: Can the thumbnail be a mockup?
A: Yes, if it accurately shows what the buyer receives. Most listings also need at least one unedited photo of the actual item; print-on-demand items can use an authorised stock mockup instead, according to Etsy.

## Etsy Variations for Wall Art: Size, Frame and a Photo Each
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/etsy-variations-for-wall-art/
Set up Etsy variations for wall art: size and frame colour in one listing, canvas or framed print as separate listings, and a linked photo for every frame option.

Short answer: Use Etsy variations for size and frame colour, and give each frame colour its own linked photo, made in the same room so only the frame changes. Etsy lets you link a photo to each option of a variation, for up to 20 options. Sell canvas and framed prints as separate listings, because they need different photos, titles and prices. Show sizes in one size guide image rather than one photo per size.

Q: How many variations can an Etsy listing have?
A: Etsy's help page says up to 3 variation types, such as size and colour. Listings with 1 or 2 types can have up to 4,900 option combinations, and listings with 3 types up to 2,500.
Q: Can I add a different photo for each Etsy variation?
A: Yes. Turn on Link photos to this variation, then pick a photo for each option. If a variation has more than 20 options, only 20 can have photos.
Q: Should frame colour or size get the linked photos?
A: Frame colour, because it changes how the piece looks. Sizes are clearer in one size guide image that shows them side by side.
Q: Can I sell canvas and framed prints in one Etsy listing?
A: You can add a third variation for the product, but separate listings are usually clearer: each gets photos, a title and tags that match exactly what it is.
Q: Can digital downloads have variations on Etsy?
A: No. Etsy says variations are not supported for digital listings, so list each file set as it is or describe the included ratios in the listing.
Q: Do Etsy variations need different prices?
A: Only if your costs differ. Etsy lets you set different prices, SKUs and quantities for up to 400 option combinations.

## Etsy vs Shopify vs Your Own Site for Wall Art Sellers
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/etsy-vs-shopify-for-wall-art/
Etsy vs Shopify for wall art: who brings the buyers, what each charges per sale, variants and photos for canvas and framed prints, and when to run both.

Short answer: Etsy is better when you need buyers now: shoppers already search it, and you pay per listing and per sale (USD 0.20 a listing, 6.5% of each sale, plus card processing). Shopify, or your own site, is better once you can bring your own traffic from Pinterest, Instagram, email or ads: you pay a monthly plan and card fees, and you own the brand. A common path is to start on Etsy and add a store later, with the same print-on-demand provider and photos.

Q: Is Etsy or Shopify better for selling wall art?
A: Etsy is better for finding buyers quickly, because shoppers already search it. Shopify is better once you can bring your own traffic, because you pay a monthly plan instead of a percentage on every sale and you own the brand.
Q: How much does Etsy charge to sell a print?
A: For a US shop, USD 0.20 per listing, 6.5% of the item price and shipping, and 3% plus USD 0.25 for card processing. Orders from Offsite Ads add 15%, or 12% for larger shops, capped at USD 100 per order.
Q: Does Shopify charge a fee per sale?
A: Shopify charges card processing on each sale. Its pricing page also lists an extra fee on Basic (2%) when you use a third-party payment provider instead of Shopify Payments.
Q: Can I sell the same print-on-demand wall art on Etsy and Shopify?
A: Yes. The main print-on-demand providers connect to both, so one provider can fulfil orders from each. Use the same listing photos on both.
Q: Should I start on Etsy or Shopify?
A: If you don't have an audience yet, Etsy is usually the faster start. Add a Shopify store once you have repeat buyers or traffic from Pinterest, Instagram or email.

## Floating Frame Mockup Tips: Gap, Depth and Frame Colour
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/floating-frame-canvas-mockups/
How to make a floating frame canvas mockup look right: the shadow gap in millimetres and pixels, frame depth, the colour inside the gap and your provider's finish.

Short answer: A floating frame canvas mockup looks right when five details match the product: a thin, even gap between canvas and frame, the right colour inside that gap, a slim frame face, a shadow that fits the frame's depth, and the frame finish your provider ships. Use real numbers: Prodigi lists a 5 mm gap and 12 mm face, Gelato a 12 mm gap (checked 2026-10-29). Show no glass and no mat, and nothing covering the front of the canvas.

Q: How wide is the gap in a floating frame?
A: It depends on the frame. Prodigi lists a 5 mm gap and Gelato a 12 mm gap for their framed canvas (checked 2026-10-29). In a mockup, the gap should scale with the canvas, so it looks thinner on large canvases.
Q: Should a floating frame mockup show glass or a mat?
A: No. Floating frames for canvas have no glass and no mat. Reflections or a white border tell buyers it is a framed print.
Q: What colour should the gap be?
A: Usually dark, because you see the inside of the frame and its shadow. Printful says its black and brown framed canvases have a black inside and its white frames a white inside, so check your own sample.
Q: Does a floating frame cover part of the artwork?
A: No. The frame surrounds the canvas without touching its front, so the whole front of the canvas shows. Only the sides are mostly hidden.
Q: Can I make floating frame mockups for a whole collection?
A: Yes. In WallMock you save your rooms and the framed canvas look once, then add many artworks. Each one comes out in every chosen room at its own proportions.

## How to Choose Frame and Mat Proportions for Art Mockups
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/frame-and-mat-proportions/
Judge the frame face, depth, mat width and floating gap separately, with a worked example, so the frame in your mockup finishes the picture without resizing it.

Short answer: Treat the frame face, frame depth, mat width and floating gap as four separate measurements, and keep the artwork the same size while you compare finishes. As a rough front-view estimate, a 20×30 inch print with a 2 inch mat and a ½ inch frame face is about 25×35 inches overall. Start with a slim wood, black or white frame, and match the product you sell.

Q: What is the difference between frame face and frame depth?
A: The frame face is the border you see from the front; depth is how far the frame stands out from the wall. Changing one should not change the other in a mockup.
Q: How do I estimate the overall size of a framed print?
A: Add twice the mat width and twice the frame face to each artwork dimension: a 20×30 inch print with a 2 inch mat and a ½ inch face is about 25×35 inches. Use your supplier's outer dimensions when accuracy matters.
Q: What is a floating gap?
A: The reveal between a canvas and the floating frame around it, which makes the canvas look as if it floats inside the frame.

## Which Frame Colour for Wall Art? Black, White, Oak or Gold
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/frame-colours-for-wall-art-mockups/
One artwork in eight frame finishes, side by side: how black, white, natural oak, walnut, espresso, gold, silver and stretched canvas change the same piece.

Short answer: Black and natural oak are the safest defaults because they suit most artwork and most rooms. Black sharpens photography, line art and typography; white feels light in coastal, Scandinavian and nursery rooms; oak, walnut and espresso warm up paintings and botanicals; gold suits classic paintings and still lifes; silver suits cool palettes. Match the frame to the artwork first and the room second, and show only finishes you sell.

Q: What frame colour sells best for wall art?
A: There is no single answer, but black and natural oak are the safest defaults because they suit most artwork and most rooms. Choose by the artwork's palette and the buyer's likely interior.
Q: Should the frame match the furniture?
A: It helps if the frame relates to something in the room, such as a wooden table or black light fittings, but it doesn't need to match exactly. Match the artwork first.
Q: Is a gold frame old-fashioned?
A: Not with the right art. Thin gold floating frames look contemporary with abstracts and botanicals; ornate gold suits classic paintings.

## Framed Canvas vs Stretched Canvas: Which to Sell and Show
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/framed-canvas-vs-stretched-canvas/
Framed or stretched canvas? Sizes, depths and frames at Printful, Gelato and Prodigi, which art suits each product, and the listing photos each one needs.

Short answer: Sell stretched canvas when you want the widest size range and a relaxed, frameless look. Sell framed canvas when you want a finished, premium piece in common sizes. Stretched canvas goes much larger at the providers we checked: Printful lists canvas up to 40×60 in but framed canvas only up to 24×36 in (checked 2026-10-29). Show stretched canvas with its edge and wall shadow, and framed canvas with its floating gap and frame colour.

Q: Does a canvas print need a frame?
A: No. A stretched canvas is ready to hang as it is, with its sides finished. A floating frame is an optional upgrade that adds a finished edge and protects the corners.
Q: Which looks more premium, framed or stretched canvas?
A: Framed canvas usually reads as more finished and premium. Stretched canvas reads as relaxed and modern, and suits very large pieces.
Q: Can a buyer frame a stretched canvas later?
A: Yes, with a floating frame made for that canvas size and depth. Tell buyers the exact canvas size and depth so they can order the right frame.
Q: What is the largest framed canvas size?
A: It depends on the provider. Printful's and Gelato's framed canvas lists stop at 24×36 in; Prodigi lists framed canvas up to 55×55 in (checked 2026-10-29).
Q: Should I offer framed and stretched canvas in one listing?
A: You can. Use the product as a variation and link a photo to each option, ideally the same room with only the product changed.

## Framed Print With or Without a Mat: Which to Offer
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/framed-print-with-or-without-mat/
When a mat helps a framed print and when to skip it, what Printful and Prodigi offer, how a mat changes the visible art size, and how to show the mat in mockups.

Short answer: Offer a mat when the art is small, detailed or photographic, or when the buyer wants a gallery look: photography, botanicals, line art and smaller prints. Skip it for bold graphic posters, large prints and edge-to-edge designs. A mat shrinks the visible art inside a given frame, so state both the print size and the frame size. In mockups, show the mat at the width you ship: Prodigi uses 2.5 to 5 cm mounts depending on frame size (checked 2026-10-29).

Q: Does a mat make a framed print look more expensive?
A: It usually makes it look more finished and gallery-like, especially for photography and small, detailed art. Bold posters often look better without one.
Q: What size mat for a 16×20 frame?
A: It depends on the print. A 12×16 in print gets about 2.1 in of mat on every side; an 11×14 in print gets about 2.6 in at the sides and 3.1 in at top and bottom.
Q: Does the mat cover part of the print?
A: Yes, a little. The opening is usually cut about 1/8 in (3 mm) smaller than the print on each edge, so keep signatures and key detail away from the edge.
Q: Should a mat be white or off-white?
A: Either works; white is crisper and off-white softer. Use the colour your provider ships, and show the same one in every photo.
Q: Can I sell framed prints with and without a mat in one listing?
A: Yes. Add the mat as a variation and link a photo to each option, ideally the same room with only the mat changed.

## Set of 3 Wall Art: Presenting Pairs, Trios and Sets
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/gallery-wall-mockups-pairs-and-trios/
Spacing, alignment and room choice for selling art as pairs, sets of three and sets of four, with the gaps that look intentional rather than accidental.

Short answer: A set of 3 wall art sells best when the mockup makes the group look like one piece: equal gaps of about 3–6 inches (8–15 cm), a shared centre line, matching frames, and a group about two thirds to three quarters as wide as the furniture below. Show the set together on one wall, then each piece alone, and say exactly what the buyer receives.

Q: How far apart should a set of three frames be?
A: About 3–6 inches (8–15 cm) between frames is a common guideline for most sizes. Keep every gap the same.
Q: How wide should a trio be above a sofa?
A: About two thirds to three quarters of the sofa's width for the whole group, centred on the sofa.
Q: Should a set of 3 be one image split into three?
A: It can be. A split panorama reads as one artwork; three related pieces read as a series. Both sell; say clearly which one the buyer receives.

## Gelato Mockup Generator: Mockup Studio vs Room Mockups
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/gelato-mockups-for-wall-art/
What Gelato's built-in mockups and Mockup Studio do for posters, framed prints and canvas, who can use Mockup Studio, and when to add your own room photos.

Short answer: Gelato gives you two mockup tools. Every product gets scenes to choose from when you publish to Etsy or Shopify. Mockup Studio, built for wall art, lets you pick a background scene, size and place the product, add layers and download the result; Gelato says it is for Gelato+ subscribers and that others can try it. Use them for product views, and add your own room photos when you want the same rooms and frame across a whole collection.

Q: Is Gelato Mockup Studio free?
A: Gelato says Mockup Studio is available for Gelato+ subscribers, and users without a premium subscription can still try it (checked 2026-10-29).
Q: What is Gelato Mockup Studio for?
A: Gelato says it is designed for the wall art category. You pick a background scene, size and position the product, add layers such as a logo or text, and download the mockup or save it for your products.
Q: How many mockups does Gelato send to Etsy?
A: Up to 10 per product, including the main image. Etsy allows 20 photos per listing, so you can add your own room photos alongside.
Q: Can I use my own mockups with Gelato products?
A: Yes. Add them to the Etsy or Shopify listing. When connecting an existing Etsy listing, Gelato asks whether it should upload photos, so you can keep your own.
Q: Does Gelato's framed canvas have a gap?
A: Yes. Gelato's canvas guide states a 12 mm gap between the canvas and the frame, with a frame front 9–14 mm wide.
Q: Do Gelato framed posters arrive assembled?
A: Not by default. Gelato ships the frame and poster separately in one package, unless you turn on its Ready-to-Hang option.

## Gelato vs Printify vs Printful for Canvas and Framed Prints
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/gelato-vs-printify-vs-printful-wall-art/
Gelato, Printify and Printful compared for wall art only: canvas depth, framed canvas, framed posters, where they print, samples and mockups, from their own pages.

Short answer: For wall art, the three differ most in how much they tell you about framed products. Gelato states its framed canvas specs (a 12 mm gap, 13 sizes, three frame colours) and produces in 32 countries. Printful runs its own centres and gives canvas depths of 1.5, 1.25 and 0.75 in. Printify connects you to many print providers, so specs vary by product. All three connect to Etsy and Shopify. Decide by your buyers' countries and the exact frame, then order a sample.

Q: Is Gelato, Printify or Printful better for canvas prints?
A: It depends on where your buyers are and which frame you want. Gelato states framed canvas specs and produces in 32 countries, Printful makes its own canvases in its centres, and Printify lets you pick between print providers whose specs vary. Order a sample from your shortlist.
Q: Which one has a floating frame canvas?
A: Gelato states a 12 mm gap between canvas and frame (checked 2026-10-29). Printful's framed canvas page states no gap, though customer reviews describe a floater frame. On Printify it depends on the provider, so check the size guide and a sample.
Q: How deep are Printful's canvases?
A: Printful's blog gives 1.5 in for canvas, 0.75 in for thin canvas and 1.25 in for framed canvas including the frame. The post is dated March 2025, so confirm on the product page.
Q: Can I use my own mockups with Gelato, Printify and Printful?
A: Yes. Printify lets you upload custom mockups to its Mockup Library. Printful and Gelato push their own mockups, and you add your room photos directly to the Etsy or Shopify listing.
Q: Do Gelato, Printify or Printful give free samples?
A: Gelato and Printify say they don't. Gelato offers 30% off a first sample order for new sellers, and Printful offers a 20% sample discount with monthly limits.
Q: Which prints closest to buyers in Europe?
A: Gelato routes orders to local partners in 32 countries. Printful has centres in Barcelona and Birmingham, and Birmingham only ships to UK addresses. On Printify, choose a provider located in Europe.

## Giclée vs Poster Print vs Fine-Art Paper: What to Say
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/giclee-vs-poster-vs-fine-art-paper/
What giclée, poster and fine-art paper mean, what Gelato, Prodigi, Printful and Printify say about their papers, and the honest words to use in your listings.

Short answer: Giclée means an inkjet print made with pigment, archival-quality inks, usually on fine-art paper or canvas. It names a printing process, not a particular paper or quality grade. A poster is a print on lighter, lower-cost paper, matte or semi-gloss. Fine-art paper is heavier archival stock, such as Gelato's 250 gsm archival matte (checked 2026-10-29). In listings, use your provider's exact paper name and weight, and say giclée or archival only when your provider says it for that product.

Q: Is giclée better than a poster?
A: A giclée uses pigment, archival-quality inks, usually on heavier fine-art paper, so it is made to last and to reproduce colour closely. A poster is a lower-cost print for everyday decor. Which is better depends on the price and buyer.
Q: Is a giclée the same as a fine-art print?
A: Often, but not always. Giclée names the printing process; fine-art print usually names the paper. Say both only when both are true for your product.
Q: What paper weight is good for art prints?
A: Heavier paper feels more substantial. Gelato's poster papers run from 170 to 250 gsm, and Printful's matte poster paper is 189 g/m² (checked 2026-10-29).
Q: Can I call my print giclée if my provider doesn't?
A: No. Use the words your provider uses for that exact product. If it doesn't say giclée, describe the paper and ink it does name.
Q: Is matte or semi-gloss better for wall art?
A: Matte avoids glare and suits paintings and illustration. Semi-gloss or luster gives deeper blacks and suits photography.
Q: What does gsm mean?
A: Grams per square metre: the weight of the paper. A higher number means a heavier, usually thicker sheet.

## How to Make Wall Art Mockups for Etsy, Step by Step
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/how-to-make-wall-art-mockups-for-etsy/
A practical workflow for Etsy print sellers: prepare the artwork, pick rooms that fit its shape, choose the frame, keep the art exact and export listing-ready images.

Short answer: Start from your full-resolution file at its true ratio. Pick three to five rooms whose free wall fits the artwork's shape, show the frame or canvas you actually sell at a believable size, and check that the art in the mockup matches your file. Export large images and check them at thumbnail size. Set up the rooms and frame once and reuse them for the whole collection, so every listing looks consistent.

Q: How many mockups should an Etsy wall art listing have?
A: Enough to answer the buyer's questions: usually a hero room, a scale image, a product detail, two or three alternative rooms and a sizes image. Etsy allows up to 20 photos, and our listing photo guide has a plan for every slot.
Q: Can I use the same mockup rooms for every listing?
A: Yes, and a consistent set of rooms makes a shop look coherent. Rotate the hero room between listings so search results don't look identical, and choose rooms that suit each artwork's shape and palette.
Q: Do mockups have to show the exact size?
A: They should show a believable size and should not suggest a size you don't sell. Use a dedicated size image for the exact dimensions.
Q: Do I need Photoshop to make wall art mockups?
A: No. Template files need Photoshop or a similar editor, but browser-based tools, including WallMock, place the artwork for you. Photoshop gives the most manual control; a dedicated tool is faster for whole collections.

## How to Price Wall Art on Etsy: Framed Canvas and Prints
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/how-to-price-wall-art-on-etsy/
Price print-on-demand framed canvas and framed prints on Etsy: provider cost, Etsy's fees and your margin, with a formula and a worked table for each size.

Short answer: To price wall art on Etsy, add your provider's product and shipping cost, then divide by what is left after Etsy's percentage fees and your target margin. In the US, Etsy takes 6.5% of the item price and shipping, 3% plus USD 0.25 for card processing, and USD 0.20 per listing. For a 30% margin, price = (cost + 0.45) ÷ 0.605. Price every size and frame separately, because each costs a different amount to make.

Q: How much does Etsy take from a wall art sale?
A: For a US shop: USD 0.20 per listing, 6.5% of the item price and shipping, and 3% plus USD 0.25 for card processing. On a USD 129 sale with shipping included, that is USD 12.71. Offsite Ads add 15% (or 12%) on orders that came from those ads.
Q: What margin should I aim for on print-on-demand wall art?
A: There is no fixed rule. Many sellers work back from a target such as 30% of the price, then check that sales and Offsite Ads orders still make money. The formula in this guide works for any margin you choose.
Q: Should I offer free shipping on framed canvas?
A: It doesn't change Etsy's fees, because they apply to shipping too. Include shipping in the price if that suits your buyers, but price from the full cost either way.
Q: Why price each size separately?
A: Each size and frame costs a different amount to make and ship. A single price across sizes either overcharges small pieces or loses money on large ones.
Q: Does Etsy charge fees on sales tax?
A: Etsy's payment processing fee is charged on the total sale price, including shipping and any applicable sales tax. The transaction fee applies to the item price, shipping and gift wrap.

## How to Sell Wall Art on Etsy: Products, Photos, Mockups
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/how-to-sell-wall-art-on-etsy/
Sell wall art on Etsy with the right product, Etsy's current photo rules and listing mockups that match the print: framed canvas, framed prints and posters.

Short answer: To sell wall art on Etsy, decide whether you sell printables or physical prints. For prints, make them yourself or use a print provider you list as a production partner. Then build listings with up to 20 photos. Etsy needs images that show exactly what buyers receive, and usually at least one unedited photo of the real item. Add room mockups that match your frame and size, and disclose AI if you used it to make the art.

Q: How do I sell wall art on Etsy?
A: Choose printables or physical prints. For prints, use your own production or a print-on-demand partner listed on your listings. Make listings with up to 20 photos that accurately show the item, usually including one unedited photo of the real item, plus room mockups that match the frame and size.
Q: How many photos can an Etsy listing have?
A: Up to 20 photos and 2 videos of 5 to 15 seconds, according to Etsy's help page on creating a listing.
Q: What size should Etsy listing photos be?
A: Etsy recommends at least 2000 pixels in width and height, and at least 635 pixels for the first photo. Use a landscape or square first photo, in sRGB, without transparency.
Q: Are mockups allowed on Etsy?
A: Yes, as long as they accurately show what the buyer receives. Most listings also need at least one unedited photo of the real item; Etsy describes exceptions, including authorised stock mockups for some print-on-demand items. Read Etsy's Listing Image Requirements for your product.
Q: Do I need to list my print provider on Etsy?
A: Yes. If a print-on-demand company makes your items, add it as a production partner in Shop Manager and select it on each listing.
Q: Do I have to disclose AI on Etsy?
A: If an item is created with AI, Etsy requires you to say so in the listing description. That applies to the artwork itself. Edited listing photos have separate rules: they must not make the item look different. Etsy also recommends noting in your description if any listing photos were edited with AI.

## Large and Oversized Canvas Mockups: Showing Scale Honestly
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/large-canvas-mockups/
How to list 40×60 and 48×72 in canvas honestly: which walls fit, the ceiling check, a size guide image, sample photos, and room mockups that don't oversell scale.

Short answer: Oversized canvas is where room photos most often mislead, so pair every room mockup with plain numbers. State the canvas size and the outside size in inches and centimetres, add a size guide image drawn from real measurements, and check that the piece fits. A 40×60 in landscape suits an 80–90 in sofa. A 48×72 in portrait is 6 ft tall and won't fit above a sofa under an 8 ft ceiling. Use room photos for style, not as proof of size.

Q: How big is a 40×60 canvas?
A: 40 × 60 in is 101.6 × 152.4 cm, about 3 ft 4 in by 5 ft. In landscape it suits furniture about 80 to 90 in wide.
Q: What size sofa suits a 48×72 canvas?
A: In landscape, about 96 to 108 in wide, using the two-thirds to three-quarters guideline. In portrait it is 6 ft tall, too tall to hang above most sofas under an 8 ft ceiling.
Q: Can a room mockup show the exact size of a canvas?
A: Only if the scene was built to scale for that size. Treat room mockups as style photos and add a size guide drawn from real measurements.
Q: Does WallMock show canvases at true scale?
A: Partly. Enter your artwork's real size in centimetres or inches (long side 4 to 60 in). In the 332 library rooms with a published estimated wall scale, the artwork can be drawn at that size against the room's scale, and size matches show the estimate's range; other rooms use a reviewed placement size. The scale is estimated from the room photo, not measured on a wall, so check sizes against your product. Add a size guide and the dimensions to your listing.
Q: What resolution does a 48×72 canvas need?
A: 7,200 × 10,800 px at 150 DPI, or 14,400 × 21,600 px at 300 DPI. Add the wrap if the image continues round the sides.

## Mockup Licences and Commercial Use: Etsy, Shopify, Printify
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/mockup-licences-and-commercial-use/
What mockup licences usually allow and forbid, what to check before using bought, free or generated mockups on Etsy, Shopify and Printify, and WallMock's terms.

Short answer: Usually yes, for selling your own artwork, but the licence decides. Most mockup licences let you show your design in the scene on listings, stores and ads, and forbid reselling the empty scene or turning it into your own templates. Free mockups vary the most, so check for attribution and limits. Etsy adds its own rule: a stock mockup for a print-on-demand item must be authorised by its owner. This is general information, not legal advice.

Q: Can I use mockups I bought on Etsy for my own listings?
A: Usually, if the licence allows commercial use. Read the licence in the listing or download, save it, and watch for packs sold for personal use only.
Q: Can I use free mockups commercially?
A: Sometimes. Free mockups have the widest range of terms: some need a credit, some forbid marketplaces or ads. Check the exact licence for each file.
Q: Can I sell templates made from someone else's mockups?
A: Almost never. Most licences forbid reselling or giving away the scene, the PSD or a template made from it, even if you change it.
Q: Can I use WallMock mockups on Etsy, Shopify and Printify?
A: Yes. WallMock's terms allow clean downloads in shop listings, online stores and print-on-demand product pages, as well as websites, social posts, ads and client presentations.
Q: Can I keep using WallMock images after I cancel?
A: Yes. The terms say the licence to the room scenes and frames in your finished images lasts as long as you use them, including after you cancel or close your account.
Q: Is this legal advice?
A: No. It is general information to help you read a licence. For a specific question about your rights, ask the licensor or a lawyer.

## Mockups for Printable Wall Art (Digital Downloads)
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/mockups-for-printable-wall-art/
What buyers of printable art need to see before they buy: the art in a room, the frame they'll likely use, the ratios included and how printing works.

Short answer: Show a printable the way buyers will display it: in a thin black, white or natural oak frame with a white mat, in three to five rooms. Say 'digital download, no physical item shipped' in the first lines and on one image, add an image listing the ratio files and the sizes each prints, and explain how to print. Keep the artwork exact and the frame consistent across the listing.

Q: What frame should I show for a printable?
A: A simple thin frame with a white mat, in black, white or natural oak, matches how most buyers will display the print.
Q: How many files should a printable listing include?
A: Many sellers include five ratio files (2:3, 3:4, 4:5, 11×14 and ISO A) so buyers can print most standard sizes.
Q: Should I put a watermark on printable mockups?
A: Many sellers add a small, subtle mark to mockups to discourage copying. Keep it away from the centre of the art so it doesn't spoil the hero image.

## Panoramic and Tall Art Mockups: 3:1 and 1:3 Wall Art
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/panoramic-and-tall-art-mockups/
Wide panoramas and tall narrow prints need very different rooms. Where to place them, how big to show them, common sizes and the mistakes to avoid.

Short answer: Show a 3:1 or 2:1 panorama above something long, such as a sofa, bed or sideboard, at about two thirds of its width and 6–10 inches (15–25 cm) above it. Show a 1:3 or 1:2 tall print on a narrow wall: a pier between doors, a niche, a stairwell or beside a window. Keep the true proportions, and never crop either shape to fit a standard template.

Q: Where should a panoramic print hang?
A: Above a long piece of furniture such as a sofa, bed or sideboard, centred on it, at roughly two thirds of its width.
Q: Where does a tall narrow print look best?
A: On a narrow wall: between two doors, beside a window, in a niche or on a stairwell.
Q: Can I split a panorama into three canvases?
A: Yes. A triptych reads as one artwork across three pieces; keep the gaps even and say clearly that the buyer receives three panels.

## PSD Frame Mockups vs an Online Generator: Time and Cost
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/photoshop-frame-mockups-vs-online-generator/
How PSD smart-object frame mockups work, where they break for canvas and ratios, and a simple way to compare time and cost per listing with an online generator.

Short answer: A PSD frame mockup is a Photoshop file with a smart object where your art goes: you replace its contents, check the fit and export, once per design per template. It gives full control and works with your own photos, but each template suits one ratio and every image is a manual step. Cost per image = template price ÷ images made + minutes × your hourly value. Time yourself on five designs, then compare.

Q: What is a smart object mockup?
A: A Photoshop file where the artwork area is a smart object. You replace its contents with your design, and the frame, shadows and perspective in the template are applied to it.
Q: How do I replace a smart object in Photoshop?
A: Select the smart object in the Layers panel, right-click it, choose Replace Contents, pick your file and click Place. Adobe says the new file keeps the original's transformations.
Q: Why does my art look stretched in a PSD mockup?
A: The template's smart object was made for a different ratio. Use a template made for your artwork's ratio, and check width ÷ height after export.
Q: Are PSD mockups cheaper than a subscription?
A: On money alone they can be close. Your time per image usually decides it, so time five designs, multiply by your hourly value and compare cost per image.
Q: Can I automate PSD mockups?
A: Partly. Photoshop actions and scripts can repeat the steps, but someone has to build and maintain them for each template.
Q: Can WallMock use my own PSD or room photo?
A: No. WallMock places your artwork in its own curated rooms; it doesn't take uploads of PSD templates or your own room photos.

## Print on Demand Sample Order: Check It Against Your Mockup
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/print-on-demand-sample-check/
How to order a wall art sample from Printify, Printful, Gelato or Prodigi, and a checklist to compare its colour, frame, depth, gap and mat with your mockup.

Short answer: Order one sample of your best seller in the frame colour you'll show, then compare it with your mockup in daylight: frame colour and width, depth, the gap on a floating frame, mat width, edges, colours and sharpness. Change the mockup to match the product, not the other way round. Printify and Gelato don't give free samples; Printful, Gelato and Prodigi offer sample discounts with conditions. Photograph the sample too: Etsy wants an unedited photo for most items.

Q: Is it worth ordering a print-on-demand sample?
A: Yes, for at least your best seller. It's the only way to check the frame colour, depth, gap and print colours before buyers see them, and it gives you a photo of the real item for Etsy.
Q: Does Printify give free samples?
A: No. Printify says sample orders are at regular pricing. Choose Sample after clicking Create order, and it ships to your account address.
Q: What sizes can I order as a Printful sample?
A: Printful says framed posters can only be sampled at 8×10 in and canvas at 12×12 in, with a 20% discount (checked 2026-10-29).
Q: How do I get Prodigi's sample discount?
A: Place your first sample order through Prodigi's manual order form, then email the order number to its support team for a 50% refund. It's limited to one product type per order.
Q: Does Gelato offer a sample discount?
A: New sellers get 30% off the product cost of a first sample order within 48 hours of sign-up, up to 50€ off. Gelato also runs seasonal sample discounts.
Q: Do I need a photo of the real item on Etsy?
A: For most items, Etsy requires at least one unedited photo of the actual item. Print-on-demand sellers may use an authorised stock photo mockup instead; a photo of your sample is the simplest option.

## Print Ratios and Sizes for Wall Art: 2:3, 3:4, 4:5, A Sizes
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/print-ratios-and-sizes-for-wall-art/
Which print sizes share a ratio, the files digital-download sellers usually include, and the pixels needed at 300 DPI. Inch and centimetre sizes, with tables.

Short answer: Every print size belongs to a ratio family: 2:3 (4×6 to 24×36), 3:4 (18×24), 4:5 (8×10, 16×20), 11:14, ISO A (A4 to A1, about 1:1.41) and 1:1. A file prints at every size in its own family without cropping, and needs cropping or borders for any other. For 300 DPI, multiply the inches by 300: a 24×36 inch print needs 7200×10800 pixels.

Q: Is 8×10 the same ratio as 16×20?
A: Yes, both are 4:5. 11×14 is a different ratio (11:14).
Q: Is A4 the same ratio as A3 and A2?
A: Yes. All ISO A sizes share the ratio 1:1.414, so one A file prints at every A size.
Q: What resolution do I need to print 24×36 inches?
A: 7200×10800 pixels at 300 DPI. Many sellers accept 150–200 DPI for prints this large because they are viewed from further away.
Q: Which ratio should I make my artwork?
A: 2:3 covers the most common inch sizes; add an ISO A version for buyers outside North America. If you sell digital downloads, prepare a file for each main ratio.

## Printable Wall Art vs Print on Demand: Profit and Photos
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/printable-wall-art-vs-print-on-demand/
Digital downloads vs print-on-demand framed prints and canvas: profit per sale worked out with Etsy's fees, the sales you need, and what each listing must show.

Short answer: Printables keep most of a small price; print-on-demand framed prints and canvas keep a smaller share of a much larger one. With Etsy's 6.5% transaction fee and 20-cent listing fee, our example keeps about 7 US dollars from an 8-dollar printable and about 23.50 from a 60-dollar framed print that costs 30 to make and ship: one framed sale is worth about three and a half printable sales. Printable photos show the file framed; print-on-demand photos show the exact product.

Q: Is it more profitable to sell printables or print on demand?
A: Per sale, print on demand usually keeps more money; for effort, printables are simpler. In our example a framed print kept about as much as three and a half printables. Work it out with your own prices and provider costs.
Q: What fees does Etsy charge on a sale?
A: Etsy's help page lists 20 US cents to create or renew a listing, a 6.5% transaction fee on the total order amount, a payment processing fee that varies by country, and 15% on Offsite Ads orders for shops under 10,000 US dollars a year.
Q: Can I sell the same artwork as a printable and a framed print?
A: Yes, as separate listings, each with photos and a description that match what the buyer receives.
Q: Do printables need mockups?
A: Yes. Buyers want to see the art framed in a room. Etsy also asks digital listings to include a preview of the actual content.
Q: Do print-on-demand listings need a photo of the actual product?
A: Etsy requires at least one unedited photo for most items. For print-on-demand items, it allows a stock photo mockup if its owner has authorised its use.

## Printful Canvas Mockups: Framed, Thin and Standard Canvas
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/printful-canvas-mockups/
Printful's canvas, thin canvas and framed canvas for mockups: depths, frame colours, what its free generator gives you, and the room photos to add yourself.

Short answer: Printful's free mockup generator shows your design on its canvas products, from clean studio backgrounds to lifestyle scenes, and sends the mockups you pick to your store. It can't take mockups made elsewhere, so room photos go straight into your Etsy or Shopify listing. Match the product: Printful gives 1.5 in depth for canvas, 0.75 in for thin canvas and 1.25 in for framed canvas, with black, brown or white frames.

Q: Is Printful's mockup generator free?
A: Yes. Printful says mockups for its products are free. You need a Printful account and make them from your dashboard.
Q: Can I upload my own canvas mockups to Printful?
A: No. Printful's help centre says it isn't possible to upload mockup images to Printful. Add room photos directly to your Etsy or Shopify listing.
Q: How thick is Printful's canvas?
A: Printful's blog gives 1.5 in for canvas, 0.75 in for thin canvas and 1.25 in for framed canvas including the frame. The post is dated March 2025, so confirm on the product page before you list.
Q: What colours does Printful's framed canvas come in?
A: Printful's blog lists black, brown and white frames. The framed canvas product page doesn't list colours in its text, so check the variant selector.
Q: Does Printful make AI mockups for canvas?
A: Not at the moment. Printful says AI mockups cover select apparel products only (checked 2026-10-29).
Q: What size canvas sample can I order from Printful?
A: Only 12×12 in, according to Printful's sample order article, with a 20% discount and monthly limits.

## Printful Mockups for Framed Posters and Canvas
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/printful-mockups-for-framed-posters/
How Printful's mockup generator works for framed posters and canvas, fixes for mockups that don't show or update, and how to use your own room mockups.

Short answer: Printful makes free mockups for its products. You pick a main mockup and extra styles when you publish a framed poster or canvas to your store. If they don't update on Etsy, the usual cause is a listing that already has 20 images, or an integration that adds new mockups without removing old ones. You can't upload your own mockups to Printful. Add your room photos directly to the Etsy or Shopify listing instead.

Q: Why are my Printful mockups not showing my design?
A: On Etsy, the most common reason is a listing that already has 20 images, so Printful can't push the new mockup. Use Change print file with all variants selected, or upload the new mockup to Etsy yourself.
Q: Why are my Printful mockups not updating?
A: Some integrations don't support mockup updates, or add new images without removing the old ones. Delete the old images in your store, or save the product as a template, delete it and republish with the mockups you want.
Q: Can I upload my own mockups to Printful?
A: Not at the moment, according to Printful's help center. Upload mockups made elsewhere straight to your Etsy or Shopify listing.
Q: Is Printful's mockup generator free?
A: Yes. Printful says mockups for its products are free; you need a Printful account to use them.
Q: Does Printful offer framed canvas and framed posters?
A: Yes. Printful lists framed posters on matte or luster photo paper from 8×10 to 24×36 in, and metric sizes from 21×30 to 61×91 cm. Canvas comes in framed and thin versions too. Check frame colours on the product page before you make mockups.
Q: Printful vs Printify for posters: which has better mockups?
A: Both give free product mockups. Printify lets you upload custom mockups into its library; Printful asks you to add them in your store. With either provider you can add your own room photos that match your exact product.

Printify's framed canvas products compared: frame colours, sizes, hanging hardware, where to find the depth, samples, and listing photos that match the product.

Find the depth in each product's size guide, order one sample, then make room photos in the same frame colour.

## Printify Mockups for Framed Canvas and Posters
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/printify-mockups-for-framed-canvas-and-posters/
What Printify's mockups give you for canvas and framed posters, why they may not show on Etsy, and how to add your own room mockups to a synced listing.

Short answer: Printify gives you free product mockups in its Mockup Library, and you choose which ones publish to Etsy or Shopify. For wall art they are mostly plain, generic scenes. You can upload your own room mockups in the same library (JPG, PNG or SVG). Or add them on Etsy and leave the Mockups box unticked when you republish, so Printify doesn't replace them. Keep the frame, size and finish in your mockup the same as the Printify product you sell.

Q: Why are my Printify mockups not showing on Etsy?
A: Check the publishing settings first. Publishing fails if more than 20 mockups are selected. New variants arrive without a photo if you republished with Mockups unticked. An expired Etsy connection, often after a password change, stops all publishing until you click Reconnect in Printify.
Q: How do I change from a Printify mockup to my own product photo?
A: Either upload your photo in Printify's Mockup Library (View all mockups, then Upload) and publish with Mockups ticked, or add it on Etsy and leave Mockups unticked when you next republish from Printify.
Q: Will republishing from Printify delete my own Etsy photos?
A: It can. Printify says publishing its mockups replaces your Etsy mockups, including videos. Use selective publishing and leave the Mockups box unticked to keep your own photos.
Q: What size should Printify mockups be?
A: Printify accepts uploads up to 30,000 × 30,000 px in JPG, PNG or SVG. For Etsy, aim for at least 2000 px in width and height, square or landscape for the first photo, in sRGB, with no transparency.
Q: Does Printify offer framed canvas?
A: Yes. Printify's canvas page lists stretched, gallery-wrapped and framed canvas, and its posters page lists framed posters in black or white wooden frames. Options vary by print provider, so check the product you choose.
Q: Can I use WallMock mockups with Printify products?
A: Yes. Use the same artwork file, choose the matching product and frame in WallMock, then upload the images to Printify's Mockup Library or straight to your Etsy or Shopify listing.

## Prodigi Mockup Generator: Framed Canvas, Frames and Mounts
URL: https://wallmock.com/guides/prodigi-mockups-for-wall-art/
Prodigi's 3D and AI mockups for wall art, the framed canvas, box frame and mount specs your photos must match, and when to add your own room photos.

Short answer: Prodigi makes 3D rendered mockups in its dashboard for wall art such as classic frames, box frames and stretched, framed and rolled canvas, and AI scene mockups (15 free to try). Its framed canvas is a floater frame with a 5 mm gap and a 12 mm frame face; its box frames stand 33 mm from the wall; mounts come in snow white, off-white or black. Use the 3D views for product detail, and add room photos that show the same frame, gap and mount.

Q: Does Prodigi have a mockup generator?
A: Yes. Prodigi makes 3D rendered mockups in its dashboard image editor, with three views per product, and AI scene mockups where you choose the lighting and describe the setting.
Q: Are Prodigi mockups free?
A: Prodigi says you can try 15 AI mockups free and that Prodigi Pro merchants get more access (checked 2026-10-29). Its 3D mockups are in the dashboard when you create an order.
Q: What is the gap on Prodigi's framed canvas?
A: 5 mm. Prodigi's framed canvas is a floater frame with a 12 mm frame face, 53 mm deep from the wall, around a 38 mm canvas.
Q: What colours are Prodigi mounts?
A: Snow white, off-white and black, cut from 2.4 mm acid-free card. The width is 25, 38 or 50 mm depending on the frame size.
Q: Can I create Etsy listings from Prodigi?
A: Not currently, according to Prodigi's Etsy FAQ. Create the listing on Etsy first, then import it into Prodigi and switch on fulfilment for each product.
Q: Does Prodigi framed canvas come with hanging hardware?
